turns.text: Make the-- make it my first, my last, my second.
Either my first, my second, my last، or his first, his second, his last. Pick.
So، آخر الوقت. Would this be the last time? Or can I use آخر الـ، um...
turns.en: So, 'aakher el-waqt'? Would this be the last time? Or can I use 'aakher el-'?

turns.text: لا. Cuz you said ال. Mm-hmm.
Then would you use إنو here? Last time that?
turns.en: Then would you use 'inno' here? Last time that?

turns.text: It would be إلي بس we do-- we-- it wouldn't because there's no ال.
turns.en: It would be 'illi', but it wouldn't, because there's no 'al'.

turns.text: uh, اسباني-اسبانيائي or اسبانيائي? What do you guys say?
turns.en: 'Isbani' or 'isbaniyyi'? What do you guys say?

turns.text: Would it be أنا بدو-- uh, أنا دلت،
turns.en: Would it be 'ana bidu'... or 'ana dalt'?

turns.text: uh, أستعمل. I kept u-saying or I kept using, right?
turns.en: 'Asta3mil'. I kept saying or I kept using, right?

turns.text: They're mixing up for me. It's not good.
aa5er marra ana 7akait Esbaani ana dallait asta3mel Kelmaat 3arabi kteer
That's actually very delightful to hear، but it's not good for you. So, I don't know.
Huh? [laughs] No, I think it's, uh, أنا، uh, أنا
turns.en: Huh? [laughs] No, I think it's, I...

turns.text: It's nice to hear، but it's not nice for you. So... [ضحك]
turns.en: It's nice to hear, but it's not nice for you. So... [laughs]

turns.text: would it be اسباني إلي or اسباني أني-- أني?
turns.en: Would it be 'isbani illi' or 'isbani anni'?

turns.text: Do you guys not say S-my Spanish?
Oh, we don't know طبيعي yet. That's another thing we need to learn. But yeah, اسباني طبيعي،
turns.en: Oh, we don't know 'tabe'i' yet. That's another thing we need to learn. But yeah, natural Spanish

turns.text: mm-hmm. بس إنت، إنت بتشتغل مع إسبانيين، صح؟ أو مش إسبانيين، يعني Spanish speaking people.
turns.en: Mm-hmm, but you work with Spanish people, right? Or not Spanish people, I mean Spanish-speaking people.

turns.text: Yeah، الـ قريب إن، uh, قريب الـ-الـ... Last week. قريب آخر...
turns.en: Yeah, the recent one, uh, recent... Last week. Another recent one...

turns.text: Wait, do you guys use, do you guys use last we-- no, you, you use-- I need to قبل.
turns.en: Wait, do you guys use 'last week'? No, you use... I need to say 'qabl' (before).

turns.text: Uh, قبل الـ ش-- uh, قبل
Do, do you wanna say the last month؟
What do you, you use آخر?
So you guys do use last...
You could say آخر، or you could say the past month. What's past؟
turns.en: You could say 'aakher', or you could say the past month. What's past?

turns.text: What does قبل الـ ما-- uh، قبل شهرة mean?
قبل is for ago. قبل شهر is like a month ago، before a month.
turns.en: 'Qabl' means ago; 'qabl shahr' is like a month ago, before a month.

turns.text: Okay، that makes sense. So، شهر الماضي
turns.en: Okay, that makes sense. So, the past month.

turns.text: ما استعملت اسباني كتير. Uh، مبارك ليش بس قريب.
turns.en: I didn't use Spanish a lot. Uh, why only 'qareeb' (recent)?

turns.text: el-shahar el-maadi ma esta3maletv sbaani kteer ma ba3raf laish
um, collocations on this؟ Or sure، what, what do you prefer؟
Yeah، I think just building on these last lessons and adding more.
